title: How Google solved their code migration NIGHTMARE with AI
summary: Short summary of Google's paper on using LLMs for large-scale code migrations such as int32-to-int64 IDs, JUnit upgrades and dead-flag cleanup.

assertions.quote: using their AI migration tools they have been able to really increase the number of landed changelists through 2024

verdicts.note: Migration case studies (Google, Amazon Java upgrades, Airbnb) got their scale from pairing LLMs with deterministic tooling and validation rather than free-form generation.

assertions.quote: The prompt is simple and so are the code changes but it allows devs to easily modernize 5,000 test files in a few months.

verdicts.note: Benchmarks and field studies show strong performance on well-specified, common tasks and weaker results on context-heavy, novel logic.
